findings.text: Passing only the module names discards the snapshot’s file keys, so a full run on an edited tree can supply different rule decisions while the report prints counts from the requested snapshot. Fix: Read rule counts and examples from the selected file versions and test two snapshots with the same module name but different decisions.

The status says the findings record lists the five deferred findings, but `docs/records/lean-code-store-prototype-findings.md` is absent from this commit. Fix: Keep the review ID and deferral outcome and mark the findings-record entry as pending.

Both sample texts are shorter than 400 characters, so the test still passes if the old truncation returns. Fix: Give the selected declaration more than 400 characters and assert that its complete text is returned.

The tests call the table helpers directly, so they pass if `main` omits the new top-level `reported` field or restores the old nesting under `decisions`. Fix: Run the report entry point on a small snapshot and assert the emitted JSON structure.

A directory with all required modules and one extra produces `missing for example []` and directs the user to extract all modules again. Fix: List the unexpected module names and direct the user to the facts directory for the selected snapshot.
The diagnostic embeds a five-example limit as a slice literal. Fix: Give the diagnostic limit a documented name or reuse `EXAMPLES` if the same limit should apply.
The new snapshot and reported-cause readers leave decoded JSON rows and their fields typed as `Any`. Fix: Give the snapshot rows and stored `reported` entries explicit field types before using them.
The new test docstrings describe the expected outcomes without naming the report functions they check. Fix: Name `reported_table` and `decisions_table` in their respective test docstrings.
